settings_logging_description: Record application events in memory for debugging and auditing.
settings_logging_awgm_level_description: INFO — operation results. FULL — intermediate steps and sing-box debug lines. DEBUG — full detail, including engine trace.
settings_logging_singbox_level_descripti: Sets what the engine itself writes to its log. Engine lines are filtered into the application log by the AWGM level above: debug lines from FULL, trace only from DEBUG.
settings_logging_app_buffer_description: How many entries to keep in the application log (tunnels, routing, servers, system). Default is 5000.
settings_logging_singbox_buffer_descript: The sing-box forwarder is noisy, so it gets a separate buffer to avoid pushing out application entries. Default is 5000.

settings_backup_lead: A copy of awg-manager data: tunnels, WDTT/FreeTurn, sing-box configuration, routes and settings. Files built for this particular router (kernel modules, the sing-box binary), the sing-box cache, pid files and the run/ service directory are not included: on restore the existing ones are kept, and on a new router sing-box has to be reinstalled with the button. Related processes are briefly stopped before creating or restoring; after a restore a cold restart is performed with linked tunnel ports synchronized.
settings_backup_secrets_title: The archive contains secrets in plain text:
settings_backup_secrets_text: the panel API key, private and preshared keys of tunnels and peers. Whoever gets the file gets access to the panel and the VPN. Store and share it like a password. Only the Amnezia Premium subscription key is encrypted separately; it is bound to this router and cannot be read on another one.
settings_backup_create_description: The .tar.gz archive will download in the browser right away
settings_backup_restore_description: Replaces the current data. To be able to roll back, save a backup first.
settings_backup_confirm_message: The archive "{name}" will be uploaded. Current data will be replaced, then AWG Manager will restart. Continue?
settings_mcp_access_description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Claude Code, Cursor and other agents. Access is by key only, even if web interface authentication is turned off. The set of tools and the API may still change.
settings_mcp_no_keys: No keys yet — you cannot connect without a key.
settings_mcp_read_only_description: Such a key can read state, logs and routes, but cannot change anything on the router and does not return configs with private keys.
settings_mcp_key_shown_once: The key is shown only now. Copy it into the client configuration.
settings_mcp_revoke_message: Clients using the key "{name}" will lose access.

settings_http_redirect_hint: After applying you will be redirected to the new address; if it does not open, the old one comes back in about 2 minutes.
settings_http_confirm_message: The web interface will move to port {port} ({interfaces}). You will be redirected to the new address for confirmation; without confirmation, the current address comes back in about 2 minutes.
settings_integrations_singbox_descriptio: Supports VLESS/Reality, Hysteria2, NaiveProxy. Requires Entware on external storage.
settings_integrations_bootstrap_descript: Used to resolve domains for DNS servers and tunnels; only an IP address can be used.
In FakeIP mode it is taken from here only if its own "real" DNS server is not set there, and takes effect after the next application of routing settings.
settings_integrations_bootstrap_invalid: An IP address without a port is required
settings_integrations_clash_description_: The sing-box management channel: the log, active connections, latency tests and subscription switching work through it. It listens only on 127.0.0.1 and is not exposed externally.
Change it only if port {port} is taken by a third-party package — then sing-box will not start. The form will not accept a port that is in use.
settings_integrations_clash_invalid: A port from {min} to {max} is required
settings_integrations_remove_instances_f: Remove the instances of this subsystem first
settings_integrations_hydra_guide_title: HydraRoute installation guide on GitHub (opens in a new tab)
settings_integrations_remove_proxy_messa: The subsystem binaries and its version marker will be removed from the router.
settings_integrations_remove_proxy_secon: Proxy settings will be kept — they will work again after reinstalling.
settings_integrations_remove_singbox_mes: The engine will be stopped and its files removed: the binary, the config.d configuration, the FakeIP cache and logs.
settings_integrations_remove_singbox_sec: Subscriptions, routing rules and proxy settings will be kept — they will work again after reinstalling.
